C04_S01 -- EXACT FULL SEPARABILITY BY WHITE-NOISE ABSORPTION
7 October 2026. INITIAL immutable. Complete internal proof candidate;
independent internal audits passed; external validation and priority UNKNOWN.
No finite-bit sampler.

ORIGIN AND DEPENDENCIES

Root originated the separable-ball absorption proposal and supplied its
elementary product-basis proof. Root then proposed the uniform all-N fixed-
anisotropy consequence. This worker independently reconstructed both, checked
the normalization and constants, and supplies the complete argument below.
The direct full-rank diffusion/logdet proof is FULL_RANK_STOPPING.txt; compact-
Lie generalization is COMPACT_LIE_EXTENSION.txt. Existing peer c04_s02 also
independently audits these coefficients. This is phase-two collaborative work,
not an independent frozen-INITIAL result. No model or solver agreement alone
is a proof; every load-bearing step is given or precisely referenced here.

STRONGEST CLAIM WITHOUT AN EXTRA GEOMETRY IMPORT

Fix any d>=2, alpha>0 and finite B. Let T_1,...,T_(d^2-1) be traceless
Hermitian with Tr T_aT_b=delta_ab, F_a=sum_i T_a^(i), and Q_C=sum C_ab
{F_a,F_b}/2. There is an EXPLICIT delta_*(d,alpha,B)>0 such that for EVERY
N>=1, real symmetric A with ||A||<=delta_*, and real b with ||b||<=B,

       exp[Q_(alphaI+A)/N+F_b]/Tr exp[Q_(alphaI+A)/N+F_b]

is exactly fully separable across its N qudits. The radius is extremely small,
and no arbitrary-anisotropy claim is made. Full separability permits different
local factors in each product term. Exact membership in the identical-product
mixture cone DOES NOT follow. Permutation symmetry only permits permutation-
averaging those product terms; it does not make them identical products.

For fixed alpha>0,gamma>0,M,B, the vanishing-anisotropy models
 Q_(alphaI+A N^-gamma)/N+F_b with ||A||<=M are also exactly fully separable
for all sufficiently large N, uniformly over A,b. This follows already from
the stopped exp[-cN(logN)^2] error and its polynomial full-rank cutoff.

C04_S01 PHASE TWO -- DIRECT FULL-RANK STOPPING FOR COLLECTIVE QUDITS
7 October 2026. Independent INITIAL remains immutable.
Status: complete internal derivation candidate, external proof/priority audit
and finite-bit implementation absent. Peer c04_s02 is independently checking
coefficients after authorized exposure. Its global isotropic identity and the
c07_s02 stopped Duhamel construction are attributed starting ingredients.
The direct logdet cutoff argument below was derived in this worker's phase two.

THEOREM CANDIDATE (FULL SU(d) INTERFACE)

Fix d>=2, alpha>0, gamma>0, M,B>=0. Choose any supplied traceless Hermitian
Hilbert--Schmidt orthonormal basis T_1,...,T_p of M_d, p=d^2-1,
Tr(T_a T_b)=delta_ab. For each N let A=A^T be real, ||A||<=M, and b real,
||b||<=B. They may vary with N. Put F_a=sum_(i=1)^N T_a^(i),
Q_C=sum_ab C_ab {F_a,F_b}/2, C_N=alpha I+A N^-gamma, and

             K_N=Q_(C_N)/N + sum_a b_a F_a.

Then for all sufficiently large N, uniformly over the displayed A,b, there
is a defined positive mixture sigma_N of IDENTICAL one-qudit products with

 T(e^K_N/Tr e^K_N,sigma_N) <= C exp[-c N (log N)^2].       (T1)

Constants and thresholds depend on d,alpha,gamma,M,B. No dimension-uniform
or parameter-independent decoder claim is made. A smaller field, including
b.F/N^.75, is included by replacing the supplied b with that smaller value.
For d=2, T_a=sigma_a/sqrt2 and alpha=1 give the critical baseline 2J^2/N;
the baseline A,b are rescaled by 1/2 and 1/sqrt2, respectively. Thus (T1), if
the audit passes, improves its known-parameter distance upper, including the
exp(-cN) c07_s02 candidate. It does not change the universal decoder lower.

This is a probabilistic representation/trace-distance theorem, not a claimed
polynomial-time preparation algorithm. The numerical/compiler gates appear
below. M=0 additionally admits an exact global isotropic representation;
that already-known heat/filter feature is not presented as a new discovery.

1. EXACT DIFFERENTIAL IDENTITIES

Use the full local density variable rho>0, Tr rho=1, and k(rho)=rho^tensorN.
The tangent inner product is the ordinary Hermitian Hilbert--Schmidt product.
For traceless Hermitian T define
 t_T=Tr rho T,
 V_T(rho)={T,rho}/2-t_T rho,
 R_T(rho)=-i[T,rho],
 B_T=N t_T+V_T.grad.
Normalized one-site filtering and rotation give exactly
 {F_T,k}/2=B_T k,               -i[F_T,k]=R_T.grad k.
